Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates bilateral lateral displacement of the paraspinal lines, which is a classic radiographic sign of a posterior mediastinal mass. This finding is most consistent with lymphoma (e.g., Hodgkin lymphoma), which can present with mediastinal widening and may be asymptomatic regarding respiratory function initially.
